title: Building a persistent dark fantasy world with AI: PANTHEON — SYNAPSE ECLIPSE
author: Archivista_Zero
selftext:
I'm an independent Italian creator developing PANTHEON — SYNAPSE ECLIPSE, a digital fantasy world combining mythology, interactive storytelling and exploration.

I've been using generative AI as a development partner for visual assets, narrative design, coding and interface prototyping.

One of the biggest challenges has been maintaining consistency across environments, character progression, persistent inventories, an in-game economy and interactive quests.

The project has evolved through numerous playable builds, with manual testing and revisions along the way. AI can accelerate development, but maintaining continuity and reliable game mechanics still requires careful human direction.

I'd be interested in discussing how other developers manage consistency and persistence in their AI-assisted projects.
